production.note: US model years. First: Ford's 2014 US Fiesta brochure lists the ST. Last: the ST is in the 2019 US brochure (ford-us-fiesta-brochure-2019), and Ford confirmed in April 2018 that 'Fiesta production will end next May at Ford's Cuautitlán Assembly facility in Mexico' (foxnews-fiesta-end-2018), i.e. May 2019.

body.note: Five-door hatchback only in the US.

displacementL.note: 1,596 cc. The brochure says 1.6L; the cc figure is from DSport's spec sheet (Michael Ferrara): "1,596cc" (dsport-fiesta-st-2014), a single publication. Cars.com lists '1.6 L/97' (cars-com-2014-fiesta-st).

drivetrain.note: Front-wheel drive; inferred from the brochure.

transmission.note: The ST was offered only with the six-speed manual.

powerHp.note: Quote: "197 hp @ 6,000 rpm". The same rating appears in the 2017 and 2019 US brochures.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. 2014 Fiesta ST five-door hatchback, 6-speed manual (the only configuration). Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 2,720 lbs". Edmunds gives the same for the 'ST 4dr Hatchback (1.6L 4cyl Turbo 6M)': "Curb weight: 2,720 lbs." (edmunds-2014-fiesta-st). Motor Authority's 2013 first drive quoted a Ford official putting the US five-door 'somewhere around the 2,700-pound mark' (motorauthority-fiesta-st-first-drive).

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 2,720 lb rests on Cars.com and Edmunds (databases), consistent with a Ford official's 'around 2,700 pounds' reported by Motor Authority. The cc figure (1,596) rests on one publication (DSport). A Ford US specification sheet or a major magazine's spec panel would replace both.
